method.solver: OpenFOAM v2512 simpleFoam (steady, incompressible), meshed with snappyHexMesh
method.turbulence: RANS k-omega SST; inlet 5 % intensity, mixing length 0.07 x the 16.4 mm bore; nutUSpalding and blended omega wall functions
method.schemes: 300 iterations first-order upwind, then linearUpwindV for U and limitedLinear for k and omega
method.domain: P20-P22 air from the hose spigot to the jets, a 4-bore hose section, and the open air around the nozzle (X +-30, Y -20..50, Z -95..-45 mm) with the tool, P01, P23, the Beacon and screws as obstacles; its faces are open to the room (total pressure 0)
method.blower: WS7040-24-V200 at 100 % PWM, Wonsmart's published P-Q curve
